parameters.name: AssetType
parameters.description:
The asset type. Valid values:

- ip: IP address

- domain: domain name

- url: URL

- process: process

- file: file

- host: host

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the Data Management center of Threat Analysis is deployed. Select a region based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: assets in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong)

- ap-southeast-1: assets outside China

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The user ID of the member whose data you want to view. This parameter is available only when an administrator wants to switch to the perspective of a member.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The view type.

- 0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: The view of all accounts that belong to the enterprise.
